transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net customer service. My name is Connor. How can I assist you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Connor. I'm having a very frustrating issue with my S-Net 4K TV box remote control. None of the buttons work, the voice button does nothing, and the TV box will not change channels at all.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly understand how frustrating it is when your TV remote stops responding, Marcus. Before we begin troubleshooting, may I please verify your billing address and your security question answer?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes of course. It's 38 Glenesk Road, Eltham, London, SE9 1AG. And the security question answer is my mother's maiden name, Vance.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Marcus, that verifies your account records. Now, please tell me a bit more about when this issue first occurred.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It was working perfectly fine yesterday evening, but when I sat down to watch the news this morning, the TV box was completely unresponsive to the remote. I even put brand new Duracell batteries in, but still nothing happens.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Look, remote controls are technically classed as consumable wear-and-tear accessories under our terms, so you really should just pop down to Argos or order a universal replacement online yourself.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hold on a second! I pay sixty pounds a month for this full TV and broadband package, and I only received this brand new 4K box three months ago. Why on earth should I have to go out and buy a replacement from Argos?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely hear your frustration, Marcus, and I apologize for that suggestion. Let us keep working on it together right now and see if we can get your S-Net remote re-paired without you spending any money.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you. I'd much rather try fixing it than wasting time and money on a new one.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So if I have understood correctly, your S-Net 4K remote stopped communicating with the TV box overnight, and even with fresh brand-new batteries installed, neither the standard navigation keys nor voice search respond. Is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, exactly. The power button on the front of the TV box itself turns the screen on, but the remote control does absolutely nothing.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Understood. Our voice remotes use dual-mode communication: standard infrared for basic power, and Bluetooth Low Energy for all channel selections, menus, and voice searches.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, that makes sense. How do we test if it is sending out any signal?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We can perform a quick diagnostic using the digital camera on your smartphone. Phone cameras can detect invisible infrared light pulses.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh, that's clever! I have my mobile phone right here in my hand.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Open your smartphone camera app, point the front tip of the remote control directly into the camera lens, and press the Standby Power button on the remote.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Let me look at the screen while pressing Power... yes! There is a bright flashing purplish-pink light flashing on the tip of the remote through the phone screen!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously that confirms the physical buttons, circuit board, and batteries are in working order, Marcus. The issue is simply that the Bluetooth pairing cache on the remote has corrupted.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Ah, what a relief that the hardware is intact. How do we wipe that pairing cache?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We perform a factory hardware reset on the remote itself. Please locate the 7 and 9 buttons on the remote number pad.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Got them. Seven and nine.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Press and hold down both the 7 and 9 buttons simultaneously, Marcus.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Holding down seven and nine together right now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Keep holding them firmly until the small LED light at the top of the remote flashes red four times.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Still holding... one, two, three, four red flashes! It just flashed four times.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Brilliant. That has completely wiped the corrupted Bluetooth profile and restored the remote to factory infrared mode.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, releasing the buttons now. What is the next step?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now point the remote directly at the S-Net TV box and press the Standby Power button.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Pointing directly at the box and pressing Power... the TV box just woke up and the main home screen appeared!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent! That proves the infrared transceiver is communicating cleanly with the sensor.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, but can we re-enable the voice search and Bluetooth features?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes. Now hold down the 1 and 3 buttons together for three seconds while holding the remote within twenty centimeters of the front panel of the TV box.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Holding one and three close to the front panel... a message just popped up on the television screen saying 'Your S-Net Voice Remote is now successfully connected via Bluetooth'!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to check, Marcus, is your broadband internet and WiFi connection at home operating smoothly as well right now?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, our broadband has been rock solid, all our tablets and phones are connected without any issue.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is good to hear. Now let us test the voice search button on the remote. Press and hold the microphone icon button and say 'BBC One'.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Holding the mic button... 'BBC One'. The screen immediately switched to BBC One HD! And the volume buttons and guide keys are all working instantly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is splendid news. The dual-mode Bluetooth profile has successfully re-authenticated with the TV box chipset.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'm so glad we got that working without needing to wait for a replacement in the post.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If that pairing cache ever hiccups after a power surge, remember that holding seven and nine resets the unit cleanly every time.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'll make a note of seven and nine on the back of the TV manual.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also check the TV box software version to ensure there are no pending firmware patches waiting to install.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Sure, how do I check that on the menu?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Press the Home button on your remote, navigate across to the Settings gear icon, and select System Info.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Pressing Home... going to Settings... System Info. It says Software Version 4.18.2.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Version 4.18.2 is the latest stable build released last Tuesday, so your box is completely up to date.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Great, so the software is fully updated.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Also check if you have any recorded programs stored on the hard drive that you would like to test playback on.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Let me go to My Recordings... I recorded the football match last night. Playing it now... picture is crisp and fast-forward works perfectly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Does the subtitle toggle button on the lower row of the remote bring up closed captions when pressed?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Pressing the SUB button... yes, English subtitles appear immediately at the bottom of the screen.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And pressing the Audio Description key toggles narrative assistance cleanly?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Pressing AD... audio track changes and the narrator voice comes through clearly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Everything is functioning exactly as it should be, Marcus.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, everything is back to normal.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have documented the Bluetooth remote re-pairing procedure on your customer account notes for future reference.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Connor, I really appreciate your patience and help.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else with your S-Net TV service or channel packages that I can assist you with today, Marcus?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that was everything. You fixed my main issue.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You may receive a brief automated customer satisfaction survey by SMS after this call; we would be very grateful if you could rate our service today.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'll make sure to give you top marks. Thanks again Connor.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Marcus. Have a wonderful rest of your day.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: You too, bye.
